proxy.comment: Your local proxy (FastLink / Clash / v2rayN etc.). url is the preferred address; with auto_detect on, the switcher verifies it at launch and otherwise falls back to the OS system proxy, then scans common local ports — no manual edit needed when you swap proxy apps
proxy.candidates_comment: Optional extras, e.g. candidates: ["http://127.0.0.1:18080"], candidate_ports: [18080]. Built-in scan already covers 7897/7890/7892/7893/7899/7895/10809/2080/2081/8080/20171/20172

markers.comment: Marker files live under %USERPROFILE% and toggle proxy per tool

opencode.comment: Desktop = Electron GUI; cli = command run in terminal

antigravity.comment: Antigravity desktop is Electron; its language_server subprocess honors HTTPS_PROXY
